verses.original: מִמְּעֵ֖י הַדָּגָֽה׃ יוֹנָ֔ה וַיִּתְפַּלֵּ֣ל אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו
verses.literal: From inside the fish Jonah prayed to the LORD his God

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר מִצָּ֥רָה לִ֛י קָ֠רָאתִי אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה וַֽיַּעֲנֵ֑נִי מִבֶּ֧טֶן שְׁא֛וֹל שִׁוַּ֖עְתִּי שָׁמַ֥עְתָּ קוֹלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer miṣ·ṣā·rāh lî qā·rā·ṯî ’el- Yah·weh way·ya·‘ă·nê·nî mib·be·ṭen šə·’ō·wl šiw·wa‘·tî šā·ma‘·tā qō·w·lî
verses.literal: saying In my distress I called to the LORD and He answered me From the belly of Sheol I called for help [and] You heard my voice

verses.original: וַתַּשְׁלִיכֵ֤נִי מְצוּלָה֙ בִּלְבַ֣ב יַמִּ֔ים וְנָהָ֖ר יְסֹבְבֵ֑נִי כָּל־ מִשְׁבָּרֶ֥יךָ וְגַלֶּ֖יךָ עָבָֽרוּ׃ עָלַ֥י
verses.transliteration: wat·taš·lî·ḵê·nî mə·ṣū·lāh bil·ḇaḇ yam·mîm wə·nā·hār yə·sō·ḇə·ḇê·nî kāl- miš·bā·re·ḵā wə·ḡal·le·ḵā ‘ā·ḇā·rū ‘ā·lay
verses.literal: For You cast me into the deep into the heart of the seas and the current swirled about me all Your breakers and waves swept over me

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֣י אָמַ֔רְתִּי נִגְרַ֖שְׁתִּי מִנֶּ֣גֶד עֵינֶ֑יךָ אַ֚ךְ לְהַבִּ֔יט אוֹסִ֣יף אֶל־ קָדְשֶֽׁךָ׃ הֵיכַ֖ל
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî ’ā·mar·tî niḡ·raš·tî min·ne·ḡeḏ ‘ê·ne·ḵā ’aḵ lə·hab·bîṭ ’ō·w·sîp̄ ’el- qāḏ·še·ḵā hê·ḵal
verses.literal: At this, I said I have been banished from Your sight yet I will look once more toward Your holy temple

verses.original: מַ֙יִם֙ אֲפָפ֤וּנִי עַד־ נֶ֔פֶשׁ תְּה֖וֹם יְסֹבְבֵ֑נִי ס֖וּף חָב֥וּשׁ לְרֹאשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: ma·yim ’ă·p̄ā·p̄ū·nî ‘aḏ- ne·p̄eš tə·hō·wm yə·sō·ḇə·ḇê·nî sūp̄ ḥā·ḇūš lə·rō·šî
verses.literal: The waters engulfed me to take my life the watery depths closed around me the seaweed wrapped around my head

verses.original: לְקִצְבֵ֤י הָרִים֙ יָרַ֔דְתִּי הָאָ֛רֶץ בַעֲדִ֖י בְּרִחֶ֥יהָ לְעוֹלָ֑ם וַתַּ֧עַל חַיַּ֖י מִשַּׁ֛חַת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lə·qiṣ·ḇê hā·rîm yā·raḏ·tî hā·’ā·reṣ ḇa·‘ă·ḏî bə·ri·ḥe·hā lə·‘ō·w·lām wat·ta·‘al ḥay·yay miš·ša·ḥaṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāy
verses.literal: To the roots of the mountains I descended the earth beneath me barred me in forever But You raised my life from the pit O LORD my God

verses.original: נַפְשִׁ֔י אֶת־ בְּהִתְעַטֵּ֤ף עָלַי֙ זָכָ֑רְתִּי יְהוָ֖ה תְּפִלָּתִ֔י וַתָּב֤וֹא אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ אֶל־ קָדְשֶֽׁךָ׃ הֵיכַ֖ל
verses.transliteration: nap̄·šî ’eṯ- bə·hiṯ·‘aṭ·ṭêp̄ ‘ā·lay zā·ḵā·rə·tî Yah·weh tə·p̄il·lā·ṯî wat·tā·ḇō·w ’ê·le·ḵā ’el- qāḏ·še·ḵā hê·ḵal
verses.literal: As my life - was fading away . . . I remembered the LORD My prayer went up to You to Your holy temple
Those who cling to worthless idols forsake [His] loving devotion

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֗י בְּק֤וֹל תּוֹדָה֙ אֶזְבְּחָה־ לָּ֔ךְ אֲשַׁלֵּ֑מָה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָדַ֖רְתִּי יְשׁוּעָ֖תָה לַיהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî bə·qō·wl tō·w·ḏāh ’ez·bə·ḥāh- lāḵ ’ă·šal·lê·māh ’ă·šer nā·ḏar·tî yə·šū·‘ā·ṯāh Yah·weh
verses.literal: But I with the voice of thanksgiving will sacrifice to You I will fulfill what I have vowed Salvation is from the LORD

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּ֥אמֶר לַדָּ֑ג וַיָּקֵ֥א אֶת־ יוֹנָ֖ה אֶל־ הַיַּבָּשָֽׁה׃פ
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer lad·dāḡ way·yā·qê ’eṯ- yō·w·nāh ’el- hay·yab·bā·šāh
verses.literal: And the LORD commanded the fish and it vomited - Jonah onto dry land
